# Flutter Leaf Platform Library - LLM Documentation

This index lists Leaf Platform documentation pages formatted for LLMs.
Each link points to a standalone Markdown file under the /llms path.

## Config

- [App Config](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/config/config.md): Singleton app configuration with build type, version display, and user agent

## System

- [System Utilities](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/system/system.md): Badge count, share, app tracking transparency, and URL launcher static utilities

## Device

- [Device Manager](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/device/device.md): Singleton device info manager with screen metrics, OS details, and cache control

## File

- [File Manager](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/file/file.md): Static file CRUD and directory operations with path_provider

## Location

- [Location Manager](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/location/location.md): Singleton GPS location manager with position stream and permission handling

## Map

- [Map Utilities](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/map/map.md): Circle containment check and custom marker bitmap generation from IconData

## Permission

- [Permission Manager](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/permission/permission.md): Singleton permission request/check with Android SDK-level adaptation

## WebView

- [WebView](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/webview/webview.md): Full-featured WebView widget with controller, JavaScript channels, and navigation handling
